text: SYNTHETIC DEMO PLAN CONTENT — NOT AN ACTUAL LINCOLN PLAN. The annual maximum is the most the plan pays for covered dental care in the plan year, January 1 through December 31, 2026. A remaining maximum is not a cash account or a guarantee of payment. Member balances come from member records.

text: SYNTHETIC DEMO PLAN CONTENT — NOT AN ACTUAL LINCOLN PLAN. Crowns are Major at 50% in network and 40% out of network. Fillings are Basic at 80% in network and 60% out of network. Root canals are Endodontic at 80% in network and 60% out of network. Percentages apply after the deductible to the lesser of charge and allowed amount, capped by remaining annual maximum.

text: SYNTHETIC DEMO PLAN CONTENT — NOT AN ACTUAL LINCOLN PLAN. For these synthetic crown, filling, and root canal scenarios only, there is no waiting period and no frequency limitation. This is a simplified demo assumption, not a Lincoln plan rule.

text: SYNTHETIC DEMO PLAN CONTENT — NOT AN ACTUAL LINCOLN PLAN. The demo deductible is $50 and annual maximum is $2,000. In-network amounts over the allowed amount are contractually written off. Out-of-network dentists may balance bill the difference. Both charge and allowed amount are required for an estimate.
